ryancbuckley edited PR #15199:

This PR:

  1. Fixes float-to-int128 conversion in the interpreter, so that values not representable in i128 are handled correctly.
  2. Makes some pedantic tweaks to the documentation on fcvt_to_sint and fcvt_to_uint to better reflect the behavior after the fix.
  3. Adds lots of tests for edge cases in float-to-int conversions that previously did not have coverage. These are only tangentially related to the above, so I'd be happy to move them to a separate PR if you'd prefer this PR be more focused.

Fixes #15198.

This PR:

  3. Adds lots of tests for edge cases in float-to-int conversions that previously did not have coverage. These are only tangentially related to the above, so I'd be happy to move them to a separate PR if you'd prefer this PR be more focused.

Fixes #15198.
